issue_context.title: Bug: Alt+Shift++" shortcut only works with Numpad Plus key
issue_context.body:
### What's the Problem?

It seems that the **New Pane**'s shortcut <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>+</kbd> only works with Numpad plus key. The other <kbd>+</kbd> key near the <kbd>Backspace</kbd> isn't working.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/88200096/177630800-a4b2d580-1c84-4a49-8bef-988b69e2d20a.png)

---
_(This is just an extra)_
Currently, the **New Pane** & **Close Pane**'s shortcut keys are so far away from each other.
|Name| Shortcut|
| - | - | 
| New Pane | <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>+</kbd>  |
| Close Pane | <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>W</kbd>  |


### Solution/Idea

Add support for <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>+ (Plus)</kbd> from number row, not just for NumpadPlus key

### Alternatives

I would suggest to rebind the shortcut key for **New Pane** nearer to **Close Pane**'s <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>W</kbd> hotkey.
For example: <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>W</kbd>

### Priorities

_No response_

### Files Version

2.3.1.0

### Windows Version

10.0.22621.160

### Comments

_No response_
